organization_or_parent_framework: NWO (Dutch Research Council), Domain Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH)
executive_summary: Forthcoming NWO call (status 'In preparation', NWO Domain Social Sciences and Humanities; research programme 'Navigeren in Transities') that aims to strengthen the capacity for action of public and private actors in societal transitions by strengthening monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) practices. Indicative budget EUR 7,000,000 and indicative closing date for full applications 17 June 2027, 14:00, both subject to change. Eligibility, consortium rules, project size and duration have not yet been published.
status_rationale: The call will fund social-science research on monitoring, evaluation and learning practices that help public and private actors act in societal transitions (NWO call page, introduction; Characteristics give an indicative EUR 7,000,000 budget and a 17 June 2027 closing date). It does not touch TenneT's field: the published description names no sector, energy system or infrastructure application, and the nearest project file, Energy boards, concerns coordinating grid expansion with regional governments rather than evaluation practice in general transitions; the call text is not yet published, so this should be reassessed if it names the energy transition.
